title: Residual Algebra for Representation-Preserving Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.07349v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning from heterogeneous representations is often reduced to feature concatenation, erasing which representation produced each error. We propose residual algebra, in which each representation retains its coordinate system and owns its unresolved residual until an explicit aggregation boundary. Fold instantiates representations as point-in-time conditional-mean fields on 10x10 rank grids, and FPRC-PQ composes them through relax-aggregate-close: each field first fits a correction to its own residual, corrected fields then meet at a fixed mean, and a shared learner closes only the aggregate's fresh residual. We formalize aggregation as a quotient by the zero-sum redistribution kernel, characterizing legal post-aggregation operators as those constant on its cosets. translated_title: 用于保持表示学习的残差代数
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07349v2 公告类型：替换  摘要：从异构表示中学习通常被简化为特征拼接，这会抹去每个错误来自哪个表示。我们提出了残差代数，其中每个表示保留其坐标系，并拥有其未解决的残差，直到明确的聚合边界。Fold将表示实例化为10x10秩网格上的时间点条件均值场，而FPRC-PQ通过松弛-聚合-闭合来组合它们：每个场首先对其自身残差进行修正，修正后的场在固定均值处相遇，共享学习器仅闭合聚合的新残差。我们将聚合形式化为零和重分布核的商，将合法的聚合后算子表征为在其陪集上恒定的算子。由此产生的组合分离了表示、局部残差估计和残差之残差估计，具有总体方差减少和一阶耦合。
tldr: 本文提出一种残差代数框架，通过保留每个表示的坐标系和残差，并在聚合时分离表示、局部残差及残差之残差估计，以提升异构表示学习的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a residual algebra framework that preserves each representation's coordinate system and residuals, separating representation, local residual estimation, and residual-of-residual estimation during aggregation to improve heterogeneous representation learning.
